correctness.rationale: The steady I equation gives E=B0(A)I/mu and exposed balance gives S=(1+cA)(mu+d)B0(A)/(mu lambda). Q,H from linear chains and awareness feedback give I(A)=(theta A-omega)/(gamma L(A)), A>A0; every strictly positive equilibrium is equivalent to Psi=Pi-dS(A,lambda)-(mu+d)B0(A)I(A)/mu=0. At lambda_c, Psi_lambda=Pi/lambda_c>0 and Psi_A is a sum of strictly negative terms, so IFT gives local positive forward branch. Independent rational arithmetic at A=3/2 reproduced exact wrong-source residual 32/175 and positive slope sign. This proves neither global endemic uniqueness nor source Hopf statements.
